subject: Acceptance criteria & milestones for SOC 2 / SIG / DPA
messages:
From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@finsecure.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance criteria and evidence for SOC 2 / SIG / DPA

Jordan —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement and InfoSec are aligning on the close checklist and we need a short, mutually agreed set of acceptance criteria to unblock contracting. High-level asks from our side: 

- SOC 2: final Type II report (preferred) or a) latest Type I plus controls evidence and a remediation plan; need scope to include API, inference, and secrets handling
- SIG / CAIQ: completed questionnaire or vendor-run summary mapping to our control set
- DPA: redline status + execution via DocuSign; we require 90-day default token retention but can discuss
- Data retention & audit logs: how long are raw logs kept, can we export audit logs (S3), and is there a mechanism for customer-initiated export for audits
- Subprocessors: current list (or a stable place you publish it)

Target timeline: procurement would like an internal close decision by 2027-05-21. Can you share a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones and owners that ties the above items to deliverable dates?

Attaching our RFI to show the scope.

Thanks,
Elena Costa
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
FinSecure, Inc.

Attachment: FinSecure_RFI_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@finsecure.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance criteria and evidence for SOC 2 / SIG / DPA

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely produce a MAP that ties each compliance gate to a deliverable and owner. Draft below (we'll attach a formal MAP doc in Drive):

Proposed MAP (draft)
- SOC 2 gate: Deliverable = latest SOC 2 report (Type II preferred). If Type II not available by milestone, deliverables = SOC 2 Type I + controls matrix + evidence artifacts (penetration test summary, encryption config, KMS attest). Owner: Redwood Compliance (Marissa). Target date: 2027-05-14 (evidence package) / 2027-06-10 (Type II expected if in process)
- SIG / CAIQ gate: Deliverable = completed CAIQ + supporting notes. Owner: Jordan / Marissa. Target date: 2027-05-16
- DPA gate: Deliverable = executed DPA in DocuSign. Owner: Jordan. Target date: 2027-05-18 (DocuSign link to follow)
- Data retention + audit logs: Deliverable = written retention policy + configuration options + example S3 export for audit. Owner: Hannah. Target date: 2027-05-16
- Subprocessors: Deliverable = current subprocessors list + notification schedule. Owner: Marissa. Target date: 2027-05-16

Notes / options:
- Token retention: default is 30 days for hosted API, but we can contractually set 90 days for FinSecure if required (configurable per tenant).
- Audit logs: we can provide daily exports to a customer-owned S3 with configurable retention; exports can be provided in CSV/NDJSON formats.
- Encryption: customer keys via KMS (AWS KMS/HSM) available for Private deployments; hosted customers can use Redwood-managed KMS with key-wrapping options
- Evidence location: we will stage artifacts in a read-only Drive link and provide a secure download for procurement/infosec.

I'm attaching a draft MAP (Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.docx). If you confirm the milestones above, we'll update dates to match your procurement window and push a revised MAP with a DocuSign DPA link. Propose a 30-minute sync Thu 2027-05-13 or Mon 2027-05-17 to finalize.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0112

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.docx (document)

From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@finsecure.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finsecure.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance criteria and evidence for SOC 2 / SIG / DPA

Jordan —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. A couple clarifications before we lock milestones: 

1) Token retention: procurement's standard is 90 days for short-term PII artifacts; is there any operational impact (latency/cost) to moving to 90 days? 
2) Audit logs: we expect logs (access, admin actions, model inputs/outputs metadata) retained for at least 90 days and accessible via daily export. Can you confirm you can provide a daily S3 export with these fields?
3) SOC 2: we require if available an in-scope Type II that covers the inference runtime. If Type II will only be available post-signature (June), we need interim compensating controls and a statement of when Type II will be provided.
4) Subprocessors: we need a current list and whether any subprocessors handle raw request content or tokens.

Procurement is asking to see a completed CAIQ where possible; if you can't provide the full CAIQ by 5/16, please at least provide completed rows for controls we flagged in the RFI (encryption, key management, retention, logging).

Thanks — looping procurement for timeline pressure.

—Elena

Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance criteria and evidence for SOC 2 / SIG / DPA

Elena —

Thanks, and great questions. Quick answers and next steps below. I'll also attach an updated MAP (pdf) with revised dates and a DocuSign link for the DPA.

1) Token retention / operational impact: moving from 30 -> 90 days increases storage costs modestly for hosted customers; performance and latency behavior are unchanged. We'll reflect the 90-day default in the MAP for FinSecure if you confirm.

2) Audit logs / export: yes — we can provide a daily export of audit logs to a customer-owned S3 bucket. Exports include timestamped admin events, request metadata (no raw payload unless requested in narrow forensic exports), user identifiers as available, and model response metadata. We can retain audit exports in our staging for 90 days and provide a retention SLA in the DPA. Owner: Hannah. Deliverable: sample S3 export + schema by 2027-05-16.

3) SOC 2: we are in the late stages of Type II; official Type II report is expected in June 2027. By 2027-05-16 we will provide: SOC 2 Type I (latest), controls matrix mapped to your RFI, pen test executive summary, and a signed attestation on when Type II will be delivered. We'll mark SOC 2 as 'conditional pass' with contractual remediation milestones if final Type II completes post-signature. Owner: Marissa.

4) Subprocessors: attached stub list and table indicating whether subprocessors handle request content. Full subprocessors list will be published to our customer portal; if any subprocessors process raw content we will flag them and provide controls.

Next steps:
- We will publish updated MAP (Redwood_MAP_v1.1.pdf) with the 90-day retention option and the dates above by end of day 2027-05-14.
- DocuSign DPA link: https://www.docusign.com/link/to/dpa-FS-081 (live when MAP accepted)
- Proposed sync: Mon 2027-05-17 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET — will send calendar invite if that works.

If procurement needs the signed DPA prior to Type II being final, we can include contractual language that ties final acceptance to receipt of the Type II report and defines remediation obligations.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0112

CC: Hannah Schmitt (Security Ops), Marissa Cole (Compliance)
